name: Old Money
about: Quiet luxury: ivory paper, deep burgundy and forest green, a high-contrast serif in caps paired with a flowing script, lace and double-rule invitation frames, and your photos full-bleed or mounted like prints. Romantic and editorial. Best for: lifestyle, coaching, wedding, interiors, fashion and any brand that wants to feel expensive.
imageStyle: Moody, warm, film-like photos in soft window light or candlelight: deep burgundy, forest green, ivory and cream tones, classic details (roses, linen, vintage cars, old buildings, wine glasses, books), people styled in cream, black or camel, nothing neon or overly bright; vertical, with the subject and face in the upper half and calm, darker space in the lower third for the words.
